items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Yeah, well, that's Willie, Edmund, and Sadie. Three of them play piano.

ctx.x: Oh yes. I have four more sisters. I mean, well, three more sisters plays piano. Living now.
Yeah, well, that's Willie, Edmund, and Sadie. Three of them play piano.
I'm the fourth one. All living. And there are some that have passed, aren't there? Well, yes, I have three passed. Two of them played, but the one passed while she was small. She was a baby Maggie.
